publication.title: Exploring user and system requirements of linked data visualization through a visual dashboard approach
publication.version: Prepublication review manuscript corresponding to 2014 Semantic Web article; final publisher pagination not assumed

source_reading.scope: Dashboard rationale, full user interaction/configuration and architecture (§§3–5), both formative studies (§6), endpoint tests (§7), selected implementation guidelines (§8) and conclusion (§9).

adjudication.basis: The .views. system implements human global/local filtering and coordinated dashboards over linked data, and the primary report includes two formative studies and separate endpoint-performance tests. Features must be coded by deployment: automatic filter-value suggestions are disabled for the public-SPARQL configuration because of performance.
